comparisons.peer_topic: Employee Culture and Engagement Survey Results
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD conducts annual global workforce surveys to measure culture and engagement; the 2024 survey results were among the best for global tech companies, with employees describing the culture as inclusive and innovative and engagement ratings in the top 10% of peers.
comparisons.comparison: Both Micron and AMD utilize annual global surveys to measure and improve employee engagement and culture. Micron explicitly states it updated its listening strategy in 2023 to encompass engagement, culture, and inclusion via the 'Micron Voice' program, while AMD conducts an annual global workforce survey to measure culture, engagement, and workplace experience, with results reviewed by its Board. Both companies view these survey mechanisms as central to understanding team member sentiment.

sentences.text: Listening to our team members is emphasized by the Micron Voice program.
In 2023, we updated our listening strategy - which encompasses engagement, culture, leadership behaviors, wellbeing and inclusion - and implemented a survey to learn more from our team members.
We conduct an annual survey of our global workforce to measure our culture, engagement, and workplace experience.
The results are reviewed by our Board of Directors and acted upon by our senior leadership team.

peer_results.rationale: The available candidates for AVGO concern Global Engineering Resources and Core Strategy/Business Model, which do not address employee engagement, listening strategies, or feedback mechanisms comparable to Micron's disclosure.

comparisons.peer_topic: Talent Development and Employee Engagement Initiatives
comparisons.peer_summary: Intel invests in talent development through training programs, rotational assignments, updated job architecture, mentoring, and employee resource groups. Employee perceptions are gathered via annual surveys, and a portion of executive and employee performance bonuses is linked to improvements in employee experience survey results.
comparisons.comparison: Both Micron and Intel rely on annual surveys to gather employee perceptions and drive improvements in workplace culture and engagement. Micron implements a survey through its 'Micron Voice' program to learn from team members regarding engagement, culture, and inclusion. Similarly, Intel uses an annual employee experience survey to allow employees to voice perceptions of the company and work experiences, linking improvements in these survey results to executive and employee performance bonuses to foster a culture of continuous improvement.

sentences.text: In 2023, we updated our listening strategy - which encompasses engagement, culture, leadership behaviors, wellbeing and inclusion - and implemented a survey to learn more from our team members.

Through our annual employee experience survey, employee inclusion survey, and manager development feedback survey, employees can voice their perceptions of the company, their managers, their work experiences, and their learning and development opportunities.

Our employees' voices are important to enable our culture of continuous improvement, and as a result, we link a portion of our executive and employee performance bonus to year-over-year improvements of our employee experience survey results.

comparisons.peer_summary: The company evaluates employee sentiment and engagement using pulse surveys, a suggestion box, and an anonymous third-party platform to gather insights and facilitate targeted actions.
comparisons.comparison: Both Micron and NVIDIA use structured feedback mechanisms, including surveys, to evaluate employee sentiment and engagement. Micron implemented a survey via the 'Micron Voice' program as part of an updated listening strategy to understand team member needs across engagement, culture, and wellbeing. NVIDIA evaluates employee sentiment and engagement using pulse surveys and an anonymous third-party platform to gain insight into the employee experience and facilitate targeted actions, aligning with Micron's goal to improve engagement through listening.
